# M10 The Quiet Pass (FOG): cross the gorge (y 11) at the three bridges, climb a pass road (x4 west, x10 centre, x14 east) or the goat track (foot only, x1..2) and take Kanbei's summit HQ '2' (10,1); Sonja's HQ '3' (18,3) sits in a pocket of the east ridge. Threat/answer: ambushes at the pass mouths in the fog -> Recons (vision 5?) and the B Copter/T Copter scout ahead, the APC and Infantry hold the bridge heads; Tanks/Md Tanks at the pass tops (vehicles must use the roads) -> Mechs and Infantry on the goat track flank them, MDT and ART on the road below; Artillery + Rockets on the summit (hold) -> Recon sight, B Copter, Infantry/Mech over the mountains out of the roads' line; Sonja's Copter -> own AA. Player start: INF4 MECH3 TANK2 MDT2 RECON3 ART2 BCO1 TCO1 AA1 APC1 (19 units), 1 base, funds 4000. Kanbei: INF4 MECH2 TANK3 MDT2 ART2 ROCK1 AA1 (15); MECH x2, ART x2 and ROCK hold on the summit. Sonja: INF2 RECON2 TANK2 BCO1 (7), INF hold the pocket. Enemy about 1.2x the player's value.
